name: FedRAMP (Consolidated Rules for 2026; FedRAMP 20x)
what_it_illuminates: Which cloud services agencies may use for Federal information, and at what assurance class
latest_release_or_status: CR26 launched 2026-06-24; mandatory 2027-01-01; new Rev5 certifications end 2027-06-11; Classes A-D
integration_detail: Keep EMST Tiers 0-1 outside scope (no Federal information collected). Publish an applicability statement mapped to the M-24-15 exclusions. If a hosted tool is ever needed, partner with a certified platform

name: GovRAMP (formerly StateRAMP)
what_it_illuminates: State and local cloud security verification
latest_release_or_status: 2025 rebrand; current program details not verified
integration_detail: Not needed for Tiers 0-1 (no state data); would apply to any hosted personnel tool

name: TX-RAMP
what_it_illuminates: State-specific cloud certification
integration_detail: Same as GovRAMP; confirm with SL for pilot states

name: OMB AI memoranda M-25-21, M-25-22 and M-26-04
what_it_illuminates: High-impact AI in employment; acquisition data rights; LLM transparency terms
latest_release_or_status: M-25-21 and M-25-22 issued 2025-04-03; M-26-04 issued 2025-12-11 with a 2-year sunset
integration_detail: Design AI-assisted features as human-adopted decision support. Ship impact-assessment inputs and system cards with Tier 2 kits

name: OPM CHCO memo: Use of AI in the Federal Hiring Process
what_it_illuminates: When AI-drafted PDs and qualifications are and are not high-impact; 5 CFR 300.103 validation; authorized tools only
integration_detail: The PD builder follows the human 'review, revise, adopt' pattern and traces duties to EMST task IDs (job-analysis linkage)

name: OMB M-26-05 Adopting a Risk-based Approach to Software and Hardware Security
what_it_illuminates: Agency-specific software assurance; optional CISA attestation; SBOM on request
integration_detail: Publish an agency security packet (SBOM, SSDF mapping, voluntary attestation form, checksums) with every release

name: Section 508 revised ICT standards and Section508.gov
what_it_illuminates: Federal accessibility conformance (WCAG 2.0 AA incorporated)
latest_release_or_status: Revised standards effective 2018; no WCAG update adopted as of Oct 2026 per USWDS
integration_detail: Publish an ACR (VPAT) for each major release; target WCAG 2.2 AA as a superset

name: DOJ ADA Title II web and mobile accessibility rule
what_it_illuminates: WCAG 2.1 AA obligations of state and local entities, including content provided through vendors
latest_release_or_status: Interim final rule 2026-04-20: compliance by 2027-04-26 (pop. 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities, special districts)
integration_detail: EMST conformance reduces state and local adopters' exposure when they embed or link EMST views; the ACR is part of the state readiness brief

name: HHS Section 504 web accessibility rule (45 CFR 84)
owner_or_host: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
what_it_illuminates: WCAG 2.1 AA duties for funding recipients
latest_release_or_status: First compliance date 2026-05-11; not extended as of April 2026
integration_detail: Tell pilot NGOs that grant terms may already bind them; covered by the WCAG 2.2 AA target

name: WCAG 2.2 (ISO/IEC 40500:2025) and the WCAG 3 draft
what_it_illuminates: Accessibility success criteria; future conformance model
latest_release_or_status: WCAG 2.2 updated 2024-12-12; ISO/IEC 40500:2025; WCAG 3 Working Draft September 2026
integration_detail: Target WCAG 2.2 AA. Test the new 2.2 criteria (2.4.11, 2.5.7, 2.5.8, 3.2.6, 3.3.7) on the gap check and pathway views

name: U.S. Web Design System (USWDS)
what_it_illuminates: Federal design patterns, accessibility guidance and data-visualization norms
integration_detail: Build the explorer on USWDS 3 tokens and components so a federal agency can rehost it on .gov; follow USWDS data-visualization guidance

name: Digital Analytics Program (DAP)
what_it_illuminates: Government-wide web analytics without PII
integration_detail: No analytics in the MVP. A federal mirror adds DAP through one include and never passes user inputs

name: Paperwork Reduction Act guidance (pra.digital.gov)
what_it_illuminates: When user research needs OMB clearance
integration_detail: NGO-sponsored research; direct observation; standardized questionnaires limited to federal employees or fewer than 10 respondents; generic clearance if an agency sponsors

name: OpenSSF Scorecard
what_it_illuminates: Repository security posture (pinned dependencies, token permissions, signed releases, SBOM, and more)
integration_detail: Scheduled Scorecard Action; target score of 7 or more by end of pilot; publish results in the security packet

name: NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
what_it_illuminates: Secure development practices agencies may reference
integration_detail: Publish an SSDF practice mapping for the EMST build and kits

name: SBOM formats (SPDX; CycloneDX) and CISA minimum elements (2025 draft)
what_it_illuminates: Machine-readable component inventories
latest_release_or_status: CISA minimum elements offered as guidance under M-26-05
integration_detail: Generate an SBOM per release for the site bundle and each kit

name: SLSA build provenance and GitHub artifact attestations
what_it_illuminates: Verifiable provenance of release artifacts
integration_detail: Sign tags and releases; attach build-provenance attestations so agencies can verify artifacts without trusting the host

name: CISA Secure by Design
what_it_illuminates: Secure defaults, vulnerability disclosure, transparency
integration_detail: SECURITY.md, a vulnerability disclosure policy, security.txt and a security changelog per release

name: Zenodo
what_it_illuminates: Citable DOIs for releases
integration_detail: Mint a DOI per release; show it on every page and export

name: O*NET OnLine, My Next Move and O*NET Web Services
owner_or_host: U.S. Department of Labor / National Center for O*NET Development
what_it_illuminates: Occupational tasks, DWAs, skills and career exploration (CC BY 4.0)
integration_detail: Map EMST tasks to O*NET tasks and DWAs (IA). Show O*NET-SOC codes on destination roles, linking out. Store IDs, not copied text

name: CareerOneStop (incl. mySkills myFuture, Skills Matcher)
what_it_illuminates: Transferable occupations; local training and credential finders
integration_detail: Refer users out for local training, credentials and job search from pathway destination pages

name: SkillsFuture Singapore Skills Framework
what_it_illuminates: Sector career pathways tied to skills: the closest precedent for EMST's pathway view
integration_detail: Borrow the sector pathway-map pattern and the split between technical and critical core skills

name: ESCO
what_it_illuminates: Open, multilingual classification that separates knowledge, skills and transversal skills
integration_detail: Typing precedent (CA); later crosswalk for international users

name: Lightcast Open Skills
what_it_illuminates: Widely embedded generic skills library
integration_detail: Crosswalk where useful for analytics; respect licence terms; keep licensed text out of the CC0 release

name: Vendor skills clouds (Workday Skills Cloud; Eightfold; SAP SuccessFactors; Oracle HCM)
what_it_illuminates: Skills inference over employee data inside one employer
integration_detail: Publish EMST in importable skills-library formats (IA) so agencies load it into systems they have already authorized (Tier 2). Be the content, not the platform

name: OpenLMP (machine-readable land management plans)
what_it_illuminates: Plan requirements as a demand signal for the workforce
integration_detail: LM and IA turn plan requirements into dated change signals on tasks. The product reuses its static-dashboard and CC0 data patterns, minus the Google Fonts request

name: Eleventy (11ty)
what_it_illuminates: Data-driven static pages with minimal client JavaScript
integration_detail: Recommended generator for the explorer: pages built from release JSON in GitHub Actions

name: Astro and Starlight
what_it_illuminates: Island-architecture static sites; Starlight has accessible documentation defaults
integration_detail: Equal alternative to Eleventy if DE prefers; larger dependency tree

name: Pagefind
what_it_illuminates: Client-side search with no server
integration_detail: Role and title search with synonyms; the index is built at build time and no queries leave the browser

name: Zensical (successor to Material for MkDocs)
what_it_illuminates: Python static documentation; used by FedRAMP's own documentation site
integration_detail: An option for a methods and documentation sub-site if DE wants Python; not for the explorer

name: GitHub Pages
what_it_illuminates: Free HTTPS static hosting tied to the repository
latest_release_or_status: Cannot set custom response headers (not re-verified)
integration_detail: Host the explorer under a steward-owned domain; CSP set through a meta tag

name: GitBook
what_it_illuminates: v1's planned public interface
integration_detail: Retire for the product (third-party SaaS; no computed views; limited accessibility control)

name: Airtable
what_it_illuminates: v1's planned working database
integration_detail: Retire as source of truth; GitHub plus CI replaces it

name: Flourish
what_it_illuminates: v1's planned visualization and story platform
integration_detail: Not in the product. One-off advocacy only, built from tagged releases after a claims review

name: System Usability Scale (SUS) and UMUX-Lite
what_it_illuminates: Comparable usability scores
integration_detail: UMUX-Lite per session and SUS at field-trial exit; PRA rules apply if an agency sponsors

name: IPCC guidance on consistent treatment of uncertainties
what_it_illuminates: Calibrated confidence and likelihood language
integration_detail: Model for EMST's fixed confidence vocabulary (low, medium, high) derived from evidence and agreement

name: CARE Principles for Indigenous Data Governance
what_it_illuminates: Authority to control and consent over Indigenous data
integration_detail: A governance flag excludes content from open builds unless TN's protocol records consent

name: 18F UX Guide and Digital.gov practitioner guides (research legal, ATO, privacy)
what_it_illuminates: PRA-aware research methods; ATO and privacy basics
latest_release_or_status: 18F guide last updated 2023; Digital.gov repo last commit 2025-04
integration_detail: Basis for the PRA-aware research plan and the agency security packet vocabulary
